Yes, for the "C" Certificate in Elementary Education: two equal installments of US$40 (LRD 6,800), the first when you register and the second before the exit examination.
For other courses, admissions will give you the approved payment schedule. All tuition must be paid before the exit examination.

TIME Inc. may grant a 50% tuition discount, subject to eligibility and approval, to eligible staff of Phìtìa Academy (PHICA), approved groups enrolling together, and students who meet the early-payment conditions.
The discount covers tuition only, not registration, exam, materials or certificate charges. Confirm your eligibility with admissions before registering.
Besides tuition:
• Registration/application fee: US$15, where applicable.
• Exit examination fee: US$10 (LRD 1,700), paid before the examination date.
Tuition covers instruction only unless stated in writing. Admissions will tell you before you enroll whether materials, exams, certificate processing or internship costs are extra.
At Phìtìa Academy (PHICA), many pupils attend tuition-free or receive significant financial help. Families who can contribute pay US$60 or less (Nursery – Grade 6).
To enrol your child, visit the school or call +231 777 891 104.
Certificates and diplomas are issued when all academic, attendance, exam and payment requirements are met.
All tuition must be paid, and financial clearance obtained, before the exit examination. The exit exam fee is US$10 (LRD 1,700).
Special Education Support Training (Cohort #1) is delivered 60% online and 40% in person through the TIME Learning portal.
To get in: create a student account, verify your email address and request enrolment in your course. Once TIME approves it, your materials, assignments and schedule appear in your account.
Special Education Support Training (Cohort #1) is a 10-week program delivered 60% online and 40% in person, through the TIME Learning portal. For its fees, ask admissions.
The "C" Certificate in Elementary Education prepares elementary teachers in core subject areas and professional teaching practice.
It runs for 9 months and costs US$80 (LRD 13,600), payable in 2 installments of US$40.
Laboratory Practical Training for Senior High Science Teachers runs for 10 weeks, plus a 2-month supervised internship.
Its tuition is confirmed by the administration before registration.
We offer 10 diploma courses. Each runs for 10 weeks and costs US$175 per course (LRD 29,750).
We offer 11 professional certificate courses. Each runs for 10 weeks and costs US$125 per course (LRD 21,250).
Skills courses include Standard English, Research Skills and Records Keeping, at US$125 per course (LRD 21,250). Duration is confirmed for each course.

Yes. TIME Inc. is an accredited supplementary teacher-training institution under the Bureau of Teacher Education, Ministry of Education, Liberia. It was established and registered with the Government of Liberia in January 2021.

TIME Inc. was founded by Dr. Philip V. Saywrayne, III (Co-founder & Executive Director), Ms. Tibeh E. Gbassagee (Co-founder, and Principal of Phìtìa Academy) and Ms. Tijue N. Suah (Co-founder, who helped coin the name).
It was established and registered with the Government of Liberia in January 2021.
Your privacy, in short:
• The public website uses no cookies, no advertising and no tracking or analytics tools.
• We only receive personal information you choose to send us: through the contact form, by WhatsApp, phone or email, or by creating a TIME Learning account.
• We use it to answer you, to run our courses and to keep records of your learning. We do not sell it or share it for marketing.
• You can ask us to see, correct or delete your information at any time.
This chat stays in your browser unless you send a message to us on WhatsApp.
Our lecturers hold qualifications ranging from master's to PhD degrees.

Phìtìa Academy (PHICA) is TIME Inc.'s sister school: a government-registered nursery, elementary and junior high school in Tower Hill, Margibi County, founded to support children whose lives were disrupted by the Ebola crisis.
Many pupils attend tuition-free or receive significant help. Families who can contribute pay US$60 or less (Nursery – Grade 6). To enrol a child, visit the school or call +231 777 891 104.

Thank you for wanting to help! Gifts provide textbooks and supplies for rural schools, benches and chalkboards, scholarships at Phìtìa Academy, teacher training and salaries, and water and sanitation at PHICA.
Books and supplies are welcome too. The quickest way to start is to message us on WhatsApp.

You can join outreach trips, teach a class, mentor students, or lend professional skills in health, finance, media or education. Churches, schools, NGOs, businesses and development partners are welcome to partner with us.

Classes and registration are at the Phìtìa Academy (PHICA) campus: Slagbaawein Oldfield, Live Smart Community, Tower Hill, behind Christian Aid Ministries, Robertsfield Highway, Margibi County, Liberia.
Open Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
Depending on the program, classes run on weekday afternoons, on Saturdays, or both:
• Weekday track: Monday, Wednesday & Friday, 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM
• Saturday track: Saturday only, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM
Registered students get their exact timetable before classes begin. The office is open Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
2027 intake:
• Registration deadline: Monday, January 4, 2027
• Classes begin: Monday, March 8, 2027
• Next intake: Thursday, October 14, 2027
These dates apply unless TIME Inc. issues an official notice changing them.
How to apply:
1. Choose your program.
2. Confirm your fees and timetable with admissions (call or WhatsApp).
3. Register by January 4, 2027 at the Phìtìa Academy campus, Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, and pay the US$15 registration fee where applicable.
4. Pay your tuition through an official TIME Inc. payment channel and keep every receipt.
5. Start classes on March 8, 2027.
Approved tuition fees:
• "C" Certificate in Elementary Education (9 months): US$80 (LRD 13,600), or 2 installments of US$40
• Professional certificate courses: US$125 per course (LRD 21,250)
• Diploma courses: US$175 per course (LRD 29,750)
• Skills courses (Standard English, Research Skills, Records Keeping): US$125 per course (LRD 21,250)
• Science lab training: confirmed by the administration before registration
Other fees: registration US$15 where applicable, and the exit exam US$10 (LRD 1,700). A 50% tuition discount may apply if you qualify.

TIME Inc. (Technical Institute for Many Empowerment) is a Liberian, government-registered institution for teacher education, skills training and humanitarian outreach to women, children and rural communities. It was established in January 2021. Our motto: "When we can help, let us help."
Call +231 777 891 104, WhatsApp +231 888 901 848, or email tinstitute312@gmail.com.
